title: ScanResult
description: Unified scan format: a local folder and the GitHub import give exactly this JSON. Input for the city layout.

rootName.description: Name of the scanned root folder.

directories.description: All folder paths (relative, with '/'), without the root itself, sorted.

emptyDirectories.description: Subset of directories: no files and only empty subfolders (recursive).

truncated.description: true if not everything was scanned because of the file limit or depth limit.

content.description: Text content; null for binary and too large files.
